sections.skill: Grow in measured steps after evidence while protecting quality

questions.prompt: Which is a sign a business is ready to grow?

choices.text: A friend saying it should grow
One very good day last year
Steady demand it is turning away

questions.correct_answer: Steady demand it is turning away
questions.intro: Grow AFTER evidence, not before. Signs a business is ready to grow: steady demand you are turning away, positive unit economics, reliable processes, and enough cash to handle the step. Grow in small steps, such as one helper, one new product or one new location, and measure the result. Protect QUALITY: if growth causes late orders, mistakes or unhappy customers, slow down and fix the process. Growing too fast can break what made the business work.

questions.prompt: The foundation is like what in business?

choices.text: A big opening party for friends

questions.intro: A builder does not add a fifth floor before checking that the foundation can hold it. Each floor is added after the ones below are solid. A business grows the same way: each step rests on proven demand, working processes and enough cash. Adding floors on a weak foundation risks the whole building, including the floors that were already safe.
